title: Canonical source registry for external skill sources
description: Versioned register of every external source evaluated for the immutable base library and the specialized catalog: skill repositories, catalog indexes, runtimes, standards, and guidance. Each entry pins provenance (URL, revision, retrieval date, license) and records the adoption decision. An entry is never authority: incorporation always requires contract conversion, Host validation, and acceptance in the destination project.

policy.description: Acquisition policy constants. All must hold for every source.

acquisition.description: How sources may be acquired. Only manual pinning to a fixed revision is allowed.

auto_install_forbidden.description: No npx, marketplace, installer, or remote fetch may run during bootstrap or accept.

staging_outside_canonical_tree.description: External material is inspected in an external staging area; the canonical tree only stores this registry and converted contracts.

host_validate_before_activation.description: Only Host validation and acceptance can move converted material toward activation.

analysis_inventory.description: Reference to the per-entry external inventory that backs the decisions in this registry. The inventory lives outside the canonical tree; only its digest and size are recorded here.

location.description: Human-readable note; must never contain local filesystem paths.

canonical_url.description: Canonical location. Required (with revision and retrieved_at) for repositories, indexes, and runtimes.

provenance_status.description: pinned: exact revision observed and recorded. unpinned: no stable revision fixed yet; the source cannot back an immutable library entry.

license.description: Declared license or licensing situation, verbatim enough to audit.

status.description: REFERENCE: consult, never import. CANDIDATE: has entries planned for contract conversion. ACTIVE: contributes converted entries accepted into the library/catalog. REJECTED: excluded.

decision_summary.description: Reasoned decision recorded by the maintainer, including what is excluded and why.
